consistency.verdict: Moving search_memory to P1 landed cleanly in most places. The phase mentions agree: the decision table (:122), the retirement table (:301), the tool count (10→8), the tool fingerprint changing only in P1 (:378, :634), the P1 list and acceptance, the costs ($0.33–0.35 adds up), the effort table, and 裁决 9, 17, 19, 21 and 22. Four majors remain. (a) Principle 4 and 裁决 23 each say the 「未整理」 fallback is the only exception to "past days only as digests", but :252 and 裁决 14 add the plan_day exception. (b) The P1 rule text promises that year queries return day digests, but the search table returns month digests, and none exist before P3. (c) Three tests that break when memory_* is deleted in P1 are missing from the test list. (d) M11 ①/② only restate the coverage guard. Separately, 「同句」/「一句」 is never defined, and under the normal reading (split at 。) the doc's own example digests fail the number guard and the cooking-kit guard. The rest are minor slips: guard naming, 「三级相同」, the 3–6 count, a stale plan_day claim, the phase-table header, P0's M1–M10, and gaps in the 未整理 search semantics.

factsExample.verdict: This round's fixes mostly landed. I checked the facts in all nine 近三天 paragraphs against V: activities.jsonl, purchases.jsonl joined to input/catalog/merchant-catalog.jsonl, and the conclude summaries and views in footprints.sqlite. Every time, name and place is correct, and every feeling traces to a same-day view. The food-coverage set is complete each day, and no count or duration is written in Chinese numerals. The new code and test citations exist and match: result_projection.py:70,91; life_agent.py:303-304, 324-337, 595; life_memory_store.py:98-110; exchange.py:11-12; 05-recording-engine.md:86-95, 642-643; and every test path and line added to 第三章. The home-dinner-1-cook summary claim holds (package 0001 content-catalog.jsonl:533). The remaining problems: (1) Five of the nine example paragraphs fail the doc's own number guard, and two of the three food paragraphs fail the cooking-kit same-sentence check, because 「句」 is never defined. (2) The pinned digest prompt does not state the coverage or name-pairing requirements that the new guards enforce. (3) The search table's 年 row returns nothing in P1 and P2. (4) The 351/437 count should be 348. (5) There are a few citation and test-list slips.
